claims: Director Leon Vance is played by Rocky Carroll.
Director Leon Vance was killed in the 500th episode of NCIS.
The 500th episode of NCIS aired on March 24, 2026.
Screen Rant reports that after 18 seasons, Director Leon Vance died in a shooting while protecting NCIS from a corrupt CID agent.
Screen Rant reports that Director Leon Vance was seen crossing over into a peaceful afterlife.
TV Insider reports that Director Leon Vance was killed in Season 23, Episode 13 of NCIS.
Season 23, Episode 13 of NCIS is titled "500".
TV Insider reports that Director Leon Vance was killed while trying to prevent the dismantling of NCIS.

According to The TV Cave and Variety, the episode featured a surreal, "fever-dream" interrogation sequence where a dying Director Leon Vance interacted with a young version of the late Ducky Mallard (Adam Campbell).
USA Today and TVLine reports that Rocky Carroll described the ending as a meaningful "love letter" to his character.
USA Today and TVLine reports that Rocky Carroll described the ending as a necessary shocking moment for the milestone episode.
USA Today and TVLine reports that Rocky Carroll noted he will return to direct.
